summary: A Swiss-modernist design-system manual for a 4-axis sans, in three numbered chapters (① design, ② system, ③ platform) plus an outro, each with its own colour. A top bar collects a tab for each chapter as you reach it. The system chapter is a set of charts (weight curve, a stacked 'onion' of weights, an automatic optical-size waterfall); 'try' and 'buy' open bottom drawers holding a 4-slider waterfall tester and a priced package sheet. Page clipped at 30,000px: the platform chapter (icons, features, encoding) and the outro come from HTML only.

instances.variantDefinition: A fixed bar or tab strip listing the page's chapters that marks the current one as you scroll (highlighted tab, or a needle moving along a dial or scale); click or drag to jump.
instances.look: Slim light-grey top bar with a red 'standard' tab left and grey 'try' / 'buy' tabs right; each chapter starts with a 40px sticky label (design, system, platform, outro) that docks into the bar as a new tab coloured like its chapter (black, yellow, blue…), so the bar grows into a breadcrumb of chapters

Red-orange field, lowercase 'gt standard' ~200px in black at top-left, then three chapter links '① design ② system ③ platform', each above a black 'a' drawing: one with Bézier nodes, one layered in offset copies, one enclosed in an @-like circle

instances.learn: Give each chapter its own animated emblem made from the same letter ('a' as nodes, layers, enclosure): the table of contents becomes a specimen
